phases.notes: src/cli touched -> tests precede impl. IMPLEMENTED: run_cli (src/main.c) routes the non-worker branch in-process under the guard via a `route_via_daemon` const (false under guard, `!index_worker` default); the worker-only in-process block was generalized with a guarded `else if (srv)` that runs cbm_mcp_handle_tool directly when maintenance_context is NULL, and `maintenance_binding_failed` is forced false under the guard so the legitimately-absent monitor is not treated as an error. maintenance_context GENERALIZATION: the LOCAL_CLI role (src/main.c) under the guard skips version_cohort construction/acquire + maintenance monitor + local transition entirely and calls handle_subcommand(argc, argv, project_locks, NULL); all cleanup helpers (main_version_cohort_close/main_local_transition_close/main_local_maintenance_finish) are NULL/uninitialized-safe (same early-goto path the default build already uses), so no lease leak / no skipped cbm_mcp_server_free. cohort_conflict + cohort_status decls and the `!cohort_manager` coordination-failure check are fenced under #ifndef. T4.3 cli.c: version_cohort.h include + the two cohort fields of cli_activation_production_context_t + the whole cohort production cluster (startup_lock_release_complete..production_context_close, plus deadline_after and startup_lock_acquire) fenced under #ifndef CBM_FORK_CLI_ONLY; cli_activation_guard becomes a direct mutation pass-through under the guard (daemon-free fork has no cohort to drain), preserving the test-ops seam. Shared helpers action_text/process_id/log_event/cleanup_fail_stop stay (reachable from the transaction-abort path). T4.4: guarded cli path never sets srv->index_executor (skips daemon delegation at mcp.c:11054) and never calls cbm_index_supervisor_mark_host() (only WORKER role main.c:3095 + daemon host do), so cbm_index_supervisor_should_wrap()==false -> index_repository runs the supervisor pipeline fully in-process, no worker subprocess, no cohort. T4.5: cli.c has ZERO socket/connect/bind/listen/accept; main.c's only socket()/connect() are in the main_daemon_ctl_* UI-control cluster reached solely via the `daemon` subcommand, never from the guarded `cli` (LOCAL_CLI->handle_subcommand->run_cli) path.
